item.title: Un fármaco de la familia de la Viagra se posiciona como candidato para hacer crecer los músculos
item.description: ¿Cómo sería crear nuevo músculo sin hacer nada de ejercicio? Pues prácticamente imposible, vamos a partir de eso. Sin embargo, sí es cierto que puede haber sustancias que ayuden a regenerar y diferenciar nuevas células musculares sin tanto entrenamiento. Sería útil para quienes no soportan el gimnasio, pero sobre todo para las personas que, por alguna enfermedad, están en reposo o no pueden hacer ejercicio físico. Es sobre todo para ellas para quienes la ciencia lleva muchos años buscando esa pastilla ideal . De momento no se ha encontrado nada infalible; pero, según un nuevo estudio, un… Fuente: Xataka.

item.title: Pope Needs No Further Treatment for Lung Cancer, Doctors Say
item.description: Pope Leo needs no further treatment for lung cancer after follow-up tests confirmed the disease was localised, the Vatican said in a statement on Wednesday. Leo, 71, had the lower lobe of his right lung removed last week in the first major health event of his 17-month pontificate. The surgery confirmed he had adenocarcinoma, the most common type of lung cancer. He left the hospital on Saturday, four days after surgery and well ahead of the week-long hospital stay the Vatican had initially... Publicado también por: France 24 - English, South China Morning Post, Sky News - World. Fuente: The New York Times - World.
item.dc:creator: Elisabetta Povoledo

item.title: Pope Leo XIV needs no further lung cancer treatment, Vatican says
item.description: Pope Leo XIV, 71, will require no further treatment for lung cancer after tests confirmed the disease was localised, the Vatican said Wednesday. The pontiff underwent surgery last week to remove part of his right lung after being diagnosed with adenocarcinoma. He was discharged Saturday and will gradually resume activities. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.title: Sienna Miller’s £1.75m thatched cottage gets a £200k price cut
item.description: Sienna Miller's thatched cottage, known as Thatch, is currently listed for £1.75 million. The cottage, located in Buckinghamshire, offers a blend of historical charm and modern amenities. Originally purchased by Miller in 2008, it features four bedrooms and a stylish country kitchen. It embraces its 16th-century character while providing a peaceful rural lifestyle. The property is presented with a reduced asking price after being initially listed at £1.95 million. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.description: Nigeria confirmó el primer caso de ébola en su territorio. La paciente es una mujer que llegó en un vuelo procedente de Uganda que tuvo que ser internada en un hospital, pero fue hasta días después que se confirmó su contagio del virus. item.title: Jeff Gordon’s foundation helped open Rwanda cancer centre; it treated 18,000+ patients by 2025
item.description: In 2012, Rwanda launched the Butaro Cancer Center of Excellence to fill the gap in cancer care services. Since then, it has treated over 18,000 individuals, greatly enhancing local healthcare. The center plays a crucial role by establishing vital diagnostic programs and training healthcare staff. However, challenges such as high drug costs and a lack of specialists remain, affecting survival rates. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: Manhattan townhouse with 41-foot pool gets $1 million price cut
item.description: Nestled at 238 West 74th Street, this pristine townhouse dating back 140 years is available for $10.45 million. Spanning around 6,460 square feet, it boasts six bedrooms and six-and-a-half bathrooms. Unique features include a splendid 41-foot heated indoor pool and lush outdoor spaces, combining modern conveniences with historic charm. Its recent renovations enhance the classic aesthetics, and it has seen several price reductions from an initial $14.945 million. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: No surprise and lasting anger: families of people who died in care homes react to Covid inquiry report
item.description: Relatives recount distress and loneliness their loved ones went through in pandemic as a result of isolation policy “At the time it felt like a devil’s bargain – it was horrible, but it was what [we thought] we had to do to keep people safe,” says Amy of the “devastating” and “terrifying” restrictions that led to her maternal grandparents being locked down in separate care homes during the early days of the Covid-19 pandemic. Eva and Eric had been married for more than 60 years when her dementia and his increased frailty meant they needed separate residential support. When the first lockdown… Fuente: The Guardian - World.

item.description: Las máquinas de protonterapia que Amancio Ortega donó al Ministerio de Sanidad en 2021 están a punto de llegar a los hospitales. item.description: After Kenya and Uganda, Nigeria has now announced its first Ebola case – a woman who was admitted to a private hospital in Abuja and travelled from Uganda. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.title: Like humans, some primates become cautious of germs in the wake of a viral outbreak
item.description: In the early days of the COVID-19 pandemic, many households wiped down groceries with disinfectant before putting them away. Hand sanitizer was in short supply. With little information on how the virus spread, people became more cautious of germs from other people. A new University of California San Diego study suggests that humans may not be alone in changing behavior after experiencing a disease threat. Fuente: Phys.org.

item.title: Suicidio en Argentina: ¿por qué es la principal causa de muerte violenta entre los jóvenes?
item.description: En Argentina, el aumento de los suicidios, especialmente entre los jóvenes, enciende las alertas sobre la salud mental. Entre las personas de 25 a 34 años, el suicidio se ha convertido en la principal causa de muerte, por delante de los accidentes de tráfico. ¿Qué hay detrás de esta realidad y cómo identificar las señales de alerta para prevenirla? Para profundizar en estas preguntas, conversamos con el doctor Demian Rodante, médico psiquiatra y psicoterapeuta especializado en salud mental. Fuente: France 24 - Español.
